source_refs.note: The methods of gene transfer (PDF 162-163); the book's list is illustrated by an original diagram.

blocks.text: The gene is transferred into the target cell through its membrane or wall without destroying the cell. To produce a whole multicellular GMO, the gene is put into a gamete or gamete-producing tissue, and such gametes are then fused to produce GMOs.

blocks.caption: Methods of gene transfer
rows: an electric current creates pores in the wall or membrane that let the gene in; the pores close after the current is discharged
a fine needle injects the gene directly into the nucleus
the gene, coated with heavy metal, is driven into the cell by mechanical force, for example a gene gun
the cell wall is removed and the protoplast is mixed with a medium containing the gene
naked DNA is combined with a chemical agent; the complex enters the cytoplasm by diffusion or endocytosis
adenovirus, adeno-associated virus, HIV, lentivirus and other retroviruses carry the gene
